title: Random Reshuffling-Based Distributed Nash Equilibrium Seeking
summary: This paper studies random reshuffling (RR)-based distributed Nash equilibrium seeking for noncooperative games. The game is motivated as a sample-average approximation of an underlying expected-value stochastic game, while the algorithmic focus is placed on the resulting finite-sum equilibrium problem. Unlike existing distributed stochastic Nash equilibrium methods that mainly rely on with-replacement sampling, the proposed approach incorporates without-replacement component updates into equilibrium computation over networks.
